rules.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named proof term sumSquaresLoopBody as the exact translated loop body; it introduces no independent mathematical fact.
Macro expansion defining sumSquaresFunctionBody from assignments, the named loop body, and return syntax.
Macro expansion defining sumSquaresDef as the translated function definition using the already defined function body.
Base equation defining the allInts domain predicate on the empty value sequence.
Recursive equation defining the allInts domain predicate on a cons sequence and descending to its tail.
Equation defining the named helper definedProjectInt to be the existing Int sort predicate.
Unproved simplification fact characterizing definedness of the pre-existing partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 contains no earlier proof of this exact rule without the rule present.
Guarded defining equation for the newly named total projection projectIntTotal in terms of the existing partial cast.
Unproved reverse-orientation simplification from the pre-existing partial cast to the proof-local total projection, adding a cast-equivalence fact used by symbolic reasoning.
Defining collapse equation for the newly named projectIntTotal helper when its argument is already statically an Int.
Unproved idempotence simplification for projectIntTotal; it is an additional reusable property rather than a constructor case defining the helper.
Unproved guarded simplification extending the pre-existing applyBin multiplication equation from statically sorted Int operands to symbolic Val operands via projection.
Unproved guarded simplification extending the pre-existing applyBin addition equation to a symbolic Int-valued Val operand via projection.
Guarded equation defining squareContribution for indices divisible by three.
Guarded equation defining squareContribution for the cube branch, where divisibility by four holds after excluding divisibility by three.
Guarded equation defining squareContribution for the unchanged-value branch.
Base equation defining the tail-recursive sumSquaresAcc summary on the empty sequence.
Recursive equation defining sumSquaresAcc on an Int-valued head by advancing the index, accumulator, and tail.
Complementary off-domain equation totalizing the proof-local sumSquaresAcc summary for a non-Int head.
